summary: Harden babysit --act local-rebase: refuse cross-repo/fork heads and origin mismatches, pin force-with-lease to headRefOid, apply collab force-push policy, and remove only stale index.lock files.
migration_impact: Agents running babysit --act against fork PRs or the wrong checkout now get a clear refusal instead of a risky unpinned force-push.
agent_notes: Cross-repo PRs, missing headRefOid, explicit PR head fetch + stale tracking refusal, REST label/author enrich (fail-closed when labels unreadable), authorship fetch fail-closed, push-remote validation via `git remote get-url --push --all origin`, collab force_push, and credential-redacted errors. Push uses --force-with-lease=refs/heads/<branch>:<oid>.
